title: A read that reports something once must not be called by the core's own code
rule: When an API read has a one-time effect (it reports a change once, then saves the state so the next read is clean), give fm-core's own callers and the shell's internal reads (CoreApi::open, start, the watcher, setup, app_info, the Tauri AppState::current_settings) a separate read that changes and reports nothing, and keep the reporting read for the API path only. Grep every caller of the reading method in fm-core and src-tauri before shipping. Test through CoreApi::open and the internal start-up calls, then assert the first API read still carries the report.
rationale: E56.3 (#663): SettingsStore::get_settings dropped unknown language ids, saved the file and reported them once in droppedLanguages; CoreApi::open called it at start for cache_limit_mb and discarded the answer, so the UI never saw the report. The tests used a bare SettingsStore and passed.
